Example PBMC dataset for miQCadj

Source: R/pbmc_sub2.R
pbmc_sub2.Rd

A subset of the pbmcsca dataset from SeuratData containing two sample–technology combinations: pbmc1 generated using Smart-seq2 and pbmc2 generated with CEL-Seq2.

Format

A Seurat object containing 33,694 features and 526 cells. The RNA assay contains raw counts, and the cell metadata include:

orig.ident

Original sample identity.

nCount_RNA

Total RNA counts per cell.

nFeature_RNA

Number of detected RNA features per cell.

percent.mito

Original proportion of counts assigned to mitochondrial genes.

percent.mt

Recomputed proportion of counts assigned to mitochondrial genes.

Cluster

Original cluster annotation.

CellType

Original cell-type annotation.

sample

Sample identifier.

tech

Sequencing technology.

sample_tech

Combined sample and technology identifier.

Source

Derived from the pbmcsca dataset distributed through the SeuratData package.

Details

The object contains raw RNA counts and cell-level metadata used to demonstrate miQC-based quality-control modelling and filtering.
